items.reason: A salicylic acid cleanser to help keep pores looking clearer and skin looking less shiny, in one simple step.
A lightweight gel moisturizer with niacinamide that adds comfort and helps balance the look of shine without feeling heavy.
A tinted mineral SPF 50 with iron oxides for daily sun protection that suits deeper skin tones and helps the look of uneven marks.

response.routine_note: Cleanse morning and evening (start with once a day if skin feels tight), follow with the gel moisturizer, and finish with sunscreen every morning. Give it a few weeks before judging results, and if spots become painful, widespread or leave marks, a dermatologist is the best next step.
